findings.issue: code-research §14.H implementation blueprint shows list_recent_pending_fingerprints and list_recent_published_fingerprints WITHOUT a conn parameter (using internal _connect()), which directly contradicts the tech-spec §Interfaces signatures, Task 2 description, and the backfill long-transaction requirement. Task 2 correctly resolves this conflict in favour of the tech-spec (conn explicit), but the hint at line 'Сохранить существующий стиль: short-lived _connect() для тех, что не принимают conn; для новых list/update/rate-limit — принимать conn явно' may not be enough to warn an implementer who opens code-research §14.H and copies the code block verbatim.
findings.fix: Add a visible warning comment to the §14.H code block in code-research.md, or remove the conflicting code from the hint entirely. In Task 2 Details block, explicitly state: 'Do NOT use the _connect()-based signatures from code-research §14.H — those are superseded by the tech-spec §Interfaces conn-explicit form.'

findings.issue: Implementation hint for E016 says 'Готовый текст alert_dedup_extractor_crash в code-research.md §14.K.3 (lines 1393-1408) — можно переименовать функцию в alert_dedup_degraded и слегка адаптировать заголовок'. The code-research template has a DIFFERENT signature (link: str, error_type: str — two params), DIFFERENT emoji (🟡 vs ⚠️ in task/tech-spec), and DIFFERENT title ('Дедуп упал (degraded mode)' vs 'Дедуп в degraded mode'). The word 'слегка адаптировать' understates the required delta. An implementer following the hint closely risks shipping the wrong signature, emoji, and heading — all of which are substring-pinned by integration tests in Wave 2.
findings.fix: Replace the vague hint with explicit deltas: rename to alert_dedup_degraded(reason: str) (single param, NOT link), emoji is ⚠️ (NOT 🟡), heading substring must be 'Дедуп в degraded mode' (NOT 'Дедуп упал'). The TDD Anchor test checks assertIn('degraded', msg) and assertIn('⚠️', msg) which locks the emoji, but not the heading substring — add assertIn('Дедуп в degraded mode', msg) to the TDD Anchor test_e016 spec to nail the contract.

findings.issue: test_all_alerts_have_unique_codes in tests/test_admin_alerts.py (line 258) calls every existing alert builder and asserts all [EXXX] codes are unique. After Task 3 lands, the three new builders will not be covered by the uniqueness sanity check, creating a silent gap.
findings.fix: Add to Task 3 Acceptance Criteria: 'Update test_all_alerts_have_unique_codes to include the three new builder calls so the uniqueness guard covers E014/E015/E016.'

findings.issue: Task 2 TDD Anchor and Acceptance Criteria both mention 'EXPECTED_PUBLISHED_COLUMNS' in test_migration.py, and the Details block says 'если есть EXPECTED_PUBLISHED_COLUMNS — обновить и его'. Actual test_migration.py (grep-verified) has NO EXPECTED_PUBLISHED_COLUMNS constant — only EXPECTED_PENDING_COLUMNS.
